source.note: Measured once during Phase 1 to derive timing only. The file itself has been deleted from the repo (third-party TikTok content, visible creator watermark) and is not read by any production code. This spec file is the only thing the renderer consumes.

countdown.method: audio piped s16le mono 24000Hz through highpass=5500,lowpass=11000; RMS in 5ms windows; peaks above 97th percentile RMS with 0.09s minimum separation; consecutive peaks grouped into runs where spacing is 0.08-0.45s
countdown.excludedAnomaly: a 2-tick group at 35.850-35.965s (spacing 0.115s) did not fit the 16-tick pattern and was treated as noise, not a real countdown run -- excluded from the medians above

reveal.method: audio piped s16le mono 24000Hz through highpass=2400,lowpass=2900; RMS in 5ms windows; peaks above 99.3rd percentile RMS with 1.0s minimum separation; gap measured from each countdown run's last tick to the next reveal peak after it

transitions.method: video scaled to 48x86 grayscale at 20fps, raw dump; spatial variance computed per frame; frames with variance below 1.3x the 5th percentile flagged as blank; consecutive blank frames grouped into runs

discardedReading.name: combinedTopAndBottomThirds
discardedReading.reason: the bottom third never drops below the blank threshold on its own -- it permanently holds the source video's TikTok logo and creator-handle overlay, which is an artifact of ref.mp4 being a downloaded post, not a property of the design being measured. Averaging it into the combined metric masked the real periodic pattern, which is only visible in the top third. Do not re-derive the combined reading; use topThirdOnly.

transitions.crossCheck: median interval independently computed from countdown-run start times (not the blank-frame detector) was 8.3225s, corroborating the 8.35s topThirdOnly reading

volume.method: ffmpeg -af volumedetect over the full file

sfx.note: Generic, hand-picked round values. Deliberately NOT derived from ref.mp4's measured spectral peaks (third-party watermarked content) -- only the timing above comes from measurement. All four are synthesized from ffmpeg lavfi sine/noise sources only, nothing sampled or extracted from any video.

tick.synthesis: white noise, highpass 6000Hz, fast attack/decay envelope

reveal.synthesis: sine 2000Hz fundamental + sine 4000Hz octave partial, exponential decay envelope

whoosh.synthesis: white noise, bandpass 800-4000Hz, rise-then-fall amplitude envelope

slide.synthesis: white noise, bandpass 300-2000Hz, smooth in/out envelope
